[Verse 1]
[B]Long distance runner, what you
[A]standin there for?
[B]Get up, get out, get
[A]out of the door
[B]You're playin cold music on the
[A]barroom floor
[B]Drowned in your laughter and
[A]dead to the core
[B]There's a dragon with matches that's
[A]loose on the town
[B]Takes a whole pail of water just to
[A]cool him down

[Chorus]
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!

[Verse 2]
[B]Almost ablaze still you
[A]don't feel the heat
[B]It takes all you got just to
[A]stay on the beat
[B]You say it's a livin, we all
[A]gotta eat
[B]But you're here alone, there's no
[A]one to compete
[B]If mercy's a business, I
[A]wish it for you
[B]More than just ashes when your
[A]dreams come true

[Chorus]
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!

[B]
[A]

[Verse 3]
[B]Long distance runner, what you
[A]holdin out for?
[B]Caught in slow motion in a
[A]dash for the door
[B]The flame from your stage has now
[A]spread to the floor
[B]You gave all you had. why you
[A]wanna give more?
[B]The more that you give, the more
[A]it will take
[B]To the thin line beyond which you
[A]really can't fake

[Chorus]
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!

[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
[B]Fire! Fire on the
[A]mountain!
title: Fire On The Mountain
